860.sql:
SELECT d.nationality
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 355 AND q.q2 LIKE '%1:40%';

stats.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.nationality FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 355 AND T1.q2 LIKE '1:40%'
